surfaces.label: Monochrome
surfaces.coverage: Twelve CISSCAL clear-filter observations in the Thomas controlled shape frame, including a regional ~100 m/pixel close frame with independently checked camera correction. Approximate disk correction and overlap levels reduce photographed illumination; shadows, variable resolution and marked gaps remain.

derived.rule: A fixed contributor separation may not exceed four diagonal pixel footprints of the coarsest frame at the emission limit, plus the mesh error when the backplanes come from the archive's own shape model. A per-sample separation scales with each footprint's own range and emission. Every displayed point samples its closest source point.

photometry.formula: D=(1-w)*cos(i)+2*w*cos(i)/(cos(i)+cos(e)); linear radiance divided by D before interpolation; D(0,0)=1.
photometry.applicationLighting: Uniform flood displays the normalized observation; Shadows applies the existing fixed-epoch Sun bank.
photometry.limitations: No phase correction, Hapke roughness correction or cast-shadow recovery. Relative display brightness, not measured albedo.

levelMatching.interpretation: Bounded relative display-level adjustment from robust overlaps; not a phase correction or recovered albedo.

display.units: relative disk-normalized I/F; linear grayscale display

areaCoverage.method: Deterministic equal-area barycentric samples on every retained triangle; excludes atlas bleed

observation.previewPolicy: The flat preview samples unique radial intersections only; the retained triangle atlas samples the closest full-source surface point in 3D.

transfer.method: Closest full-source triangle point; all bilinear observation contributors checked before interpolation; atlas bleed clamped to retained face.

surfaces.label: False color
surfaces.coverage: Five Cassini pointings in IR3, IR1 and UV3, displayed as red, green and blue. Cameras use measured registration in the published shape frame; complete three-filter footprints are combined.

derived.rule: A fixed contributor separation may not exceed four diagonal pixel footprints of the coarsest frame at the emission limit, plus the mesh error when the backplanes come from the archive's own shape model. A per-sample separation scales with each footprint's own range and emission. Every displayed point samples its closest source point.

photometry.formula: Original acquisition illumination retained; no photometric disk correction.
photometry.applicationLighting: Uniform flood displays the acquisition illumination; Shadows applies the existing fixed-epoch Sun bank.
photometry.limitations: No phase correction, Hapke roughness correction or cast-shadow recovery. Relative display brightness, not measured albedo.

levelMatching.interpretation: Bounded relative display-level adjustment from robust overlaps; not a phase correction or recovered albedo.

display.units: relative I/F in each filter, with original illumination; false colour

colorDisplay.processing: Source values remain floating point through interpolation, photometry and compositing. One common range maps the selected bands to linear display channels; IEC sRGB encoding and 8-bit quantization happen once, at output. This does not reconstruct natural color.

areaCoverage.method: Deterministic equal-area barycentric samples on every retained triangle; excludes atlas bleed

observation.previewPolicy: The flat preview samples unique radial intersections only; the retained triangle atlas samples the closest full-source surface point in 3D.

registration.method: The authored cameras are measured against their reference images; preparation refits nothing.

transfer.method: Closest full-source triangle point; all bilinear observation contributors checked before interpolation; atlas bleed clamped to retained face.

surfaces.label: Elevation
surfaces.coverage: Radius above a 135 km reference sphere from the Cassini stereo and limb shape model. This shows global relief and elongation, not a finely resolved terrain DEM; shape uncertainty reaches 6 km on the less-observed side.
